items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So you had been at the studio for how long before you met Buckin' Bubbles? ... Well, I was there going into the third week, you see.

ctx.x: He was a very nice man, you know. Everybody liked him too, see. And he used to come there, used to come to the studio, Billy Pierce Studio, you know. And --
So you had been at the studio for how long before you met Buckin' Bubbles?
Well, I was there going into the third week, you see. It was.
